meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 AI 助手改用 OpenCode 驱动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在用命令行工具管理 AI 智能体
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to OpenCode
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are managing AI agents via command line

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 系统里会多出一个叫 OpenCode 的代理后端:把 OpenCode 的代码文件复制进系统、接好依赖并重建镜像。之后每个 agent 组都可以单独把运行后端从默认的 claude 切换成 opencode,通过 OpenCode 连接 OpenRouter、DeepSeek、Anthropic 等模型服务。
howto.when: 当管理员在宿主机上对某个组执行 `ncl groups config update --provider opencode` 并把组重启后,该组的 agent 就会改用 OpenCode 运行;未设置或默认时仍用 claude。

say.text: 为 OpenRouter 注册密钥,并把对应 agent 的访问权限打开
say.note: 密钥经 OneCLI 注入容器,不落在 .env

howto.what_en: Installs the OpenCode agent provider into NanoClaw: copies provider files, wires them in, installs dependencies, rebuilds the image. Each agent group can then switch its runtime backend from the default claude to opencode, connecting to OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Anthropic, etc.
howto.when_en: After an admin runs `ncl groups config update --provider opencode` for a group and restarts it, that group's agent runs via OpenCode; otherwise it stays on claude.

say_en.text: Switch group-123's provider to opencode and restart that group
say_en.note: The group's agent will run via OpenCode

say_en.text: Configure OpenCode to use DeepSeek with model deepseek/deepseek-chat
Register an OpenRouter key and grant that agent access to it
say_en.note: The key is injected via OneCLI, not stored in .env
